experiment: Paired task-graph dispatch versus full recomputation

protocol.repeatsPerSample: Adaptive per scenario: 128 for 1k, 128 for 10k at <=1%, 32 for 10k at <=5%, 32 for 50k at <=1%, otherwise 8.
protocol.design: Each source feeds one independent task. Every changed source changes its output. Each pair measures eight repeated batches per arm; arm order is balanced and seeded. Plan build and runtime setup are reported separately from updates.
protocol.measurement: Source writes, task dispatch, and derived output updates are included; DOM, VDOM reconciliation, and paint are excluded.
